brief: A Bawan-bagh-inspired counted-thread tile: a 64x64 field split into a 4x4 grid of 16-px squares, each square holding a D2-symmetric geometric fill from a set of at least four distinct patterns (nested lozenges, chevrons, zig-zag lines, dots), every mark on a 2-px stitch cell, square borders in yellow, ground visible only as 1-px outlines, maximum five colours including ground.
